metadata.title: Synthetic Training Manual: Priority Before Routine

page_1.title: Purpose and inputs
page_1.raw_text:
Purpose and inputs

SYNTHETIC TRAINING ONLY. This is not clinical guidance.

Record whether either synthetic danger indicator A or B is present and whether a routine condition is present.

The two danger indicators are required before any routine result may be recorded.

blocks.text: SYNTHETIC TRAINING ONLY. This is not clinical guidance.
Record whether either synthetic danger indicator A or B is present and whether a routine condition is present.

page_2.title: Priority rule
page_2.raw_text:
Priority rule

If either synthetic danger indicator is present, record SYNTHETIC_PRIORITY_EXIT.

SYNTHETIC_PRIORITY_EXIT takes precedence over every routine condition.

Only when both danger indicators are recorded absent may the CHW evaluate the routine condition.

blocks.text: If either synthetic danger indicator is present, record SYNTHETIC_PRIORITY_EXIT.
SYNTHETIC_PRIORITY_EXIT takes precedence over every routine condition.
Only when both danger indicators are recorded absent may the CHW evaluate the routine condition.

page_3.title: Missingness rule
page_3.raw_text:
Missingness rule

If either required danger indicator is missing, record incomplete assessment and do not take the routine branch.

A missing indicator is unknown, not false.

Record which required input is missing for review.
